clips.title: The story
paras: In Auberdine, Archaeologist Hollee tracks dwarven research across Darkshore. The ancient ruins draw Ironforge scholars to the coast, where she keeps in touch with prospectors searching for relics and unusual geological formations.

Archaeologist Hollee works from Auberdine, among the night elves who guard and settle Darkshore. The dwarven scholar is a regional contact for surveyors and expedition teams crossing the wilderness. The Explorers' League sends its people across the sea to uncover traces of ancient history, and Darkshore's ruins give them ground to study.
